name: dev-workflow
description: Orchestrated code-work workflow with a spec review gate that cuts over-engineering before code is written.

interface.shortDescription: Spec, spec review, delegate, review, PR.
interface.longDescription: The dev-workflow skill runs code work from survey through decision questions, spec, spec review, delegated implementation, two-axis review, PR, and runtime evidence. The spec-review skill has a fresh reviewer ask of every spec item whether it is YAGNI, whether it pays for its code, and whether a simpler path exists.
